episodes.title: Steven Hassan: HOW MINDS GET HACKED
episodes.description:
"I grew up one mile from D. Trump's family home, I have known him my entire professional life, and in my view he is a malignant narcissist. He displays the same traits Fromm described in Hitler."

Steven Hassan — American psychologist and one of the world's leading experts on sects, cults, and psychological manipulation. In the 1970s he was himself a member of the Moon cult; after a deprogramming organized by his family, he has been helping people leave destructive cults since 1976. He directs the Freedom of Mind Resource Center and is the author of Combating Cult Mind Control and Freedom of Mind; his book The Cult of Trump has also been published in Czech. He created the BITE Model, a tool for identifying authoritarian control over behavior, information, thought, and emotion.
